title: Signature
summary: Sign with a finger, pen or mouse, or type a name. The signature is saved as a trimmed PNG with the task's attachments.
description:
A signature pad for approvals, deliveries, inspections and consent forms. People sign with a finger on a phone, a pen on a tablet or a mouse on a desktop, undo a stroke or clear the pad, then press "Use this signature". The signature is trimmed to its ink, saved as a PNG through the same storage as the Attachments field, and the field keeps a reference to that file.

Keyboard and screen reader users can choose "Type your name instead": the name is drawn in a handwriting font and saved the same way. Completed tasks, emails and the mobile app show the signature file; the form shows the image with a "Signed" badge and, while the task is open, a "Sign again" button.

Choose the ink colour, a white or transparent background, the pad height and the prompt under the signing line.

changelog.notes: Declares its workflow output: the signature as a file list (unchanged; attach it or read its storage_ref).

uses: Customer sign-off on a delivery or a completed job
Manager approval on an expense or purchase request
Consent and acknowledgement on onboarding or safety forms
setup: Install the package: the control appears in Extensibility → Form controls and in the form designer's palette under Custom.
Drag Signature onto a form. It uses the form's file storage (the same limits as an Attachments field), so no other setup is needed.
Optionally set the ink colour, background, pad height, prompt and whether a typed signature is allowed in the properties panel.

preview.label: Customer signature
preview.note: In the preview the signature is not stored; on a form it is saved with the task's attachments.
